findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 12 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.
Book correction: In the second step the book writes \lim_{x \to a} 5 with x \to a under the limit. All three limits in this example are as x \to 1: \lim_{x \to 1} x + \lim_{x \to 1} 5 = 1 + 5 = 6.

Book correction: The book prints the middle step as \frac{\lim f(3x + 4)}{\lim g(x + 3)}, with stray letters f and g. Here f(x) = 3x + 4 and g(x) = x + 3 themselves, so the step is \dfrac{\lim_{x \to 2}(3x + 4)}{\lim_{x \to 2}(x + 3)}.
